title: macOS CoreAudio discovery slice
description:
Keep a minimal native macOS backend for: device enumeration, device names, supported input/output config ranges, default input/output config.

Goals:
- Deterministic, testable surface
- Clear error mapping (OSStatus -> error variants)
- Non-native targets build with stubs

title: Reduce panics in macOS wbtests
description: Replace unconditional panic branches in macos/*_wbtest.mbt with explicit invariant checks or tolerant assertions (e.g. handle Unknown buffer size where it can happen; treat missing devices as OK). Goal: tests should fail only on real regressions, not environment quirks.

title: macOS error mapping parity
description:
Improve DefaultStreamConfigError/CoreAudioError mapping from OSStatus where feasible:
- Map kAudioHardwareBadDeviceError / kAudioHardwareNotRunningError etc to DeviceNotAvailable
- Map format unsupported errors to StreamTypeNotSupported

Keep BackendSpecific(op, status) as fallback.

title: JACK backend: device + stream
description: Implement JACK backend on Linux using the unified callback-thread model. Provide a CI-validated smoke test using jackd dummy driver.
notes: 2026-02-04: Implemented JACK backend (Linux) with callback-thread model (JACK process callback + per-channel ringbuffers + MoonBit worker thread). Added cmd/jack_stream_smoke and wired platform dynamic dispatch + available_hosts. CI ubuntu now installs jackd2/libjack and runs jackd dummy + jack smoke.

title: Project hygiene (bd/CI/docs)
description: Repository-level work: bd issue workflow, CI for MoonBit targets, docs parity notes, and release hygiene.

title: CI: run moon test on core + macOS
description:
Add GitHub Actions:
- ubuntu-latest: run Total tests: 4, passed: 4, failed: 0. (pure core only)
- macos-latest: run Total tests: 8, passed: 8, failed: 0. (includes macos package tests)
Optionally also run  for faster feedback.

description:
Run ✓ Git hooks installed successfully

Installed hooks:
  - post-checkout
  - prepare-commit-msg
  - pre-commit
  - post-merge

title: Initial commit + push scaffold
description:
Repo currently has no commits. Create the initial commit containing:
- MoonBit packages + tests
- README/UPSTREAM/AGENTS
- bd issue JSONL + .gitattributes
Then  to origin.

title: Pure core parity (types/heuristics/time)
description:
Port and maintain the deterministic, portable subset of RustAudio/cpal pinned in UPSTREAM.md.

Scope:
- cpal-like core types (StreamConfig, SupportedStreamConfig*, buffer size, sample rates)
- heuristics for default config selection
- StreamInstant/Duration timestamp arithmetic
- SampleFormat helpers

Non-goals (for this epic): platform audio backends beyond deterministic discovery.

title: SupportedStreamConfigRange sample-rate helpers
description:
Add API parity for:
- SupportedStreamConfigRange::with_sample_rate(sample_rate) -> SupportedStreamConfig (panics on out-of-range, like upstream)
- SupportedStreamConfigRange::try_with_sample_rate(sample_rate) -> SupportedStreamConfig?
- SupportedStreamConfigRange::with_max_sample_rate() -> SupportedStreamConfig

Then add MoonBit tests that lock the behavior (range check + buffer_size passthrough + sample_format passthrough).

title: Audit upstream core API surface vs MoonBit
description: From pinned commit in cpal-reference, list which pure-core items are already ported and which are missing (types, methods, constants). Output as a short checklist in a tracked doc (e.g. CORE_PARITY.md) with links to upstream paths/lines.
notes: Added CORE_PARITY.md checklist (ported/missing/out-of-scope) against pinned upstream commit.

title: Timestamp callback info types
description:
Port cpal core timestamp structs from upstream lib.rs:
- InputStreamTimestamp / OutputStreamTimestamp (capture callback/stream instants)
- InputCallbackInfo / OutputCallbackInfo wrappers

Keep them pure-data + deterministic. Add tests for basic constructors/accessors and StreamInstant interactions.

title: CPAL upstream parity (native-only)
description: Track full file-by-file parity with cpal-reference (native-only) including porting upstream unit tests and matching behavior. Use bd tasks for each upstream module/test chunk; ship versions via moon publish.

title: Null backend scaffold

notes: Added new package zhengyu/moon_cpal/null with Null Host/Device and tests.

title: Dynamic host/device wrappers
description: Add dynamically-dispatched Host/Device/Stream types (similar to upstream platform::Host) so users can switch backends at runtime. Start with CoreAudio + Null.
notes: Added new package zhengyu/moon_cpal/platform with dynamic Host/Device wrappers for Null + CoreAudio (best-effort, error-tolerant). Also adjusted HostId to pub(all) so subpackages can construct variants.

title: HostId + HostUnavailable
description: Port HostId list and string roundtrip + parse errors. Provide available_hosts for current target (initially: native -> CoreAudio, wasm -> Null). Add tests.
notes: Implemented HostId + HostUnavailable + available_hosts (native vs non-native) and tests.

title: Shared error types (BackendSpecific/DefaultStreamConfig/etc)
description: Port core error types from upstream cpal/error.rs into the root package and refactor existing macos package to use them instead of backend-local errors where applicable.
notes: Added cpal_error.mbt (BackendSpecificError + DefaultStreamConfigError + SupportedStreamConfigsError) and refactored macos package to raise root DefaultStreamConfigError via helper constructors.

title: Error parity expansion (BuildStream/Play/Pause/Stream)
description: Port remaining core error enums from upstream error.rs: BuildStreamError, PlayStreamError, PauseStreamError, StreamError (with BackendSpecificError). Add minimal helper constructors as needed for cross-package backends.
notes: Extended cpal_error.mbt with BuildStreamError/PlayStreamError/PauseStreamError/StreamError and added helper constructors + tests.

title: Platform Host/Device/Stream API (error-raising)
description: Implement a spec-aligned, error-raising Host/Device/Stream API in the zhengyu/moon_cpal/platform package (no dependency cycles), wrapping null + macos backends. Add Stream/build_*_stream/play/pause stubs in null and macos packages so platform can compile end-to-end; CoreAudio stream bodies remain TODO for moon_cpal-uao.3.*.
acceptance_criteria:
- Root exports Host/Device/Stream + methods matching spec signatures
- host_from_id rejects unsupported HostId with HostUnavailable
- build_*_stream stubs compile on all targets
- moon test --target wasm and --target native pass
notes: 2026-02-02: Start implementing root Host/Device/Stream wrapper (opaque) over null + macos discovery.
close_reason: Platform API now raises root errors; added Stream/build/play/pause stubs for null + macos; updated platform tests

title: UTF-8: encode MoonBit String to UTF-8 bytes (for Windows endpoint IDs)
description:
We currently use @moon_cpal.string_to_ascii_bytes when passing device IDs into native backends. This breaks for non-ASCII identifiers (notably WASAPI endpoint IDs or friendly names) because non-ASCII chars become ?.

Acceptance:
- Provide a String->UTF8 Bytes encoder (MoonBit or C helper)
- Switch WASAPI stream/device-name FFI callers to use UTF-8 encoding, not ASCII
- Add a unit test that round-trips a non-ASCII string through encode+decode
notes: 2026-02-04: Added string_to_utf8_bytes() and tests; switched WASAPI stream/device-name callers to use UTF-8 encoding instead of ASCII (endpoint IDs safe).

title: Behavior parity: platform invariants + more use cases
description: Add cross-platform behavior parity checks (host availability, host_from_id, device/config invariants) and expand use-case coverage via non-audio enumerate/report commands that run in CI.
notes: 2026-02-04: Added cmd/enumerate (host/device/config report) and platform native parity tests (available_hosts includes Null + Linux Jack, host_from_id works for advertised hosts). CI now runs cmd/enumerate on ubuntu/macos/windows.

title: WASAPI behavior parity: real default/supported configs
description: Replace WASAPI supported_{input,output}_configs and default_{input,output}_config stubs with values derived from the device mix format (IAudioClient::GetMixFormat). Add tests to keep output config behavior stable in CI.
notes: 2026-02-04: Implemented WASAPI default/supported config queries via IAudioClient::GetMixFormat (new FFI moon_cpal_wasapi_default_config_u32). Updated supported_{in,out}_configs and default_{in,out}_config to use these values (with stub fallback). Added wasapi_config_test.mbt (Windows best-effort) to keep behavior stable.

title: ALSA: real supported/default configs
description: Implement ALSA supported configs and default config using real libasound hw_params queries (formats, channels, sample rates, buffer size) and match upstream selection heuristics.

title: JACK: real supported/default configs
description: Implement JACK supported configs and default config using live server sample_rate/buffer_size query; align with upstream defaults (float32 only, fixed sample rate, fixed buffer size, supported channel list).

title: Device enumeration: closer to CPAL
description: Make per-backend Host::devices and default_{input,output}_device selection closer to upstream cpal (filter unusable devices, prefer devices that actually support the requested stream type; keep ordering stable). Update enumerate cmd expectations if needed.

title: BufferSize::Fixed semantics
description: Align BufferSize::Default vs Fixed semantics with upstream backends (at least ALSA + JACK): Default should not hardcode/force a fixed period size; Fixed should validate/attempt to set period/buffer appropriately and validate on backends where server-controlled (JACK).

title: Stream errors + callback timing tests
description: Improve StreamError mapping (e.g., ENODEV->DeviceNotAvailable, EPIPE->BufferUnderrun) and add more use cases/tests for callback timestamp monotonicity + play/pause ordering (prefer deterministic/unit tests where possible; otherwise strengthen CI smoke commands).

title: Finer error classification
description: Improve error mapping across backends: map common ALSA errno / WASAPI HRESULT / CoreAudio OSStatus to CPAL error variants (BuildStreamError, Play/PauseStreamError, StreamError) and add targeted unit tests where feasible.

title: Implement spec package (real API)
description: Replace spec/impl_stub.mbt placeholders with real implementations backed by platform dynamic dispatch. Make spec types aliases of platform types (Host/Device/Stream) and @moon_cpal.Data, and forward all methods.

title: Data + sample layer
description: Implement Data buffer abstraction and sample conversion layer (Sample/FromSample/SizedSample, I24/U24) with tests. This unlocks raw/typed stream callbacks.
close_reason: All child tasks complete: sample traits (I24/U24) + Data buffer layer implemented.

description: Port upstream cpal sample traits (Sample, FromSample, SizedSample) and 24-bit integer sample newtypes (I24/U24). Start with deterministic unit tests (ported where possible) and implement until green.
acceptance_criteria: - Public API exists in root package and is reflected in pkg.generated.mbti\n- Unit tests cover conversion behavior and sizes\n- moon test --target wasm and --target native pass
notes: 2026-02-02: Start implementing Sample/SizedSample/FromSample traits and I24/U24 sample newtypes in root package.

- Data exposes sample_format/len/bytes
- Safe typed accessors exist for U8/I16/U16/F32 (Option-returning)

title: Typed stream convenience API
description: Add CPAL-like typed stream helpers (analogous to DeviceTrait build_input_stream T / build_output_stream T) on top of the dynamic Data callbacks. Decide safe MoonBit surface (explicit SampleFormat-specific helpers or generic with runtime checks) and add tests/examples.

title: Enrich DeviceDescription metadata
description: Improve backend Device::description() beyond name/driver/direction: best-effort manufacturer/interface/address on WASAPI/CoreAudio/ALSA/JACK. Keep CI-stable; add deterministic unit tests for formatting and builder behavior.

title: WASAPI: supported_*_configs parity via IsFormatSupported
description:
Implement WASAPI format probing closer to upstream cpal:
- Use IAudioClient::IsFormatSupported (shared mode) to enumerate common sample formats (F32/I16/U16), rates, and channels.
- Populate SupportedStreamConfigRange with accurate min/max sample rates when possible (or conservative ranges if not).
- Add CI-stable unit tests (Windows-only best-effort) asserting the default config is included in supported configs.

title: DeviceDescription: manufacturer/interface metadata (CoreAudio/WASAPI)
description:
Enrich DeviceDescription fields beyond name/driver/direction:
- CoreAudio: query manufacturer + UID/address (AudioObject properties) where available.
- WASAPI: query manufacturer/interface/form-factor (property store keys) where available.
- Keep best-effort behavior (never hard-fail enumeration on missing properties).
- Add unit tests that validate non-empty name and stable fields; skip hardware-dependent asserts.

title: Data: expand codecs to more SampleFormat variants
description:
Extend @moon_cpal.Data typed decode/encode coverage:
- Add try_as/write for I32, U32, F64 at minimum; consider I8/U24/I24.
- Add tests for little-endian roundtrips and format mismatch.
- Decide how to represent 24-bit samples (packed bytes vs helper newtypes) while keeping API simple.
close_reason: Expanded Data codecs to cover I8/I16/I24/I32/I64, U8/U16/U24/U32/U64, F32/F64 with LE read/write helpers and new wbtests.

title: Error mapping: finer categories + parity
description:
Improve error mapping granularity across backends (ALSA/JACK/CoreAudio/WASAPI) to better match upstream CPAL semantics.
- Add/extend unit tests for mapping (backend-specific OSStatus/HRESULT/errno -> cpal Error variants).
- Ensure stream build/play/pause/close paths surface consistent errors.
- Keep CI-stable: avoid hardware-specific assertions.

close_reason: All CoreAudio stream tasks complete (build/play/pause/cleanup/tests + callback bridging). Streams now deliver input/output data callbacks on macOS native.

- Stream::play and Stream::pause return proper errors

acceptance_criteria:

title: Port upstream CoreAudio macOS stream tests
description: Port cpal-reference/src/host/coreaudio/macos/mod.rs tests (test_play/test_record/test_record_output) as MoonBit smoke tests. Gate via env (CI/permissions) and keep runtime short.
acceptance_criteria: - Smoke tests exist and are skipped safely on CI\n- When run locally on macOS with permissions, tests exercise stream build + play
notes: Add MoonBit smoke tests mirroring upstream coreaudio/macos mod.rs tests (best-effort, CI-safe).
close_reason: Ported upstream CoreAudio macOS stream tests as best-effort MoonBit smoke tests (CI-safe).

title: CoreAudio: output stream callback bridging
description: Bridge AudioQueue output buffers to MoonBit data callback and propagate runtime errors to error callback. Prefer FuncRef-based callback ABI (see MoonBit FFI callback pattern) and avoid calling into MoonBit from non-main threads unless runtime guarantees safety.
acceptance_criteria:
- Output data callback receives Data + OutputCallbackInfo
- Buffer size and sample format match selected config
- Errors call error callback and map to StreamError/PlayStreamError
- cmd/macos_stream_smoke demonstrates non-silent output via callback
close_reason: Implemented AudioQueue output callback bridging (MoonBit trampolines + Data buffer copy) and updated macos_stream_smoke to generate audible output + count callbacks.

title: CoreAudio: input stream callback bridging
description: Bridge AudioQueue input capture buffers to MoonBit data callback, filling InputCallbackInfo timestamps. Gate or document macOS microphone permissions; keep CI-safe by default.
acceptance_criteria:
- Input data callback receives Data + InputCallbackInfo
- Timestamp fields behave monotonically
- Errors call error callback
- Local smoke demonstrates printing first samples
close_reason: Implemented AudioQueue input callback bridging (MoonBit trampolines + timestamping) and updated macos_stream_smoke to print first samples + count callbacks.

title: CoreAudio: stream resource cleanup on drop
description: Ensure native stream resources are released when Stream is dropped (no explicit close required). Likely via moonbit_make_external_object + finalize in C stub, or an internal refcounted handle type. Keep Show/Eq stability for platform wrappers.
acceptance_criteria:
- Dropping Stream stops/disposes AudioQueue
- Repeated create/drop does not leak (best-effort, manual)
- Stream::close becomes optional or internal
notes: Implement StreamOwner external object + finalizer for AudioQueue destroy; refactor Stream::play/pause to use owner.
close_reason: Stream now owns an external StreamOwner with a finalizer that destroys AudioQueue resources; close is idempotent but drop handles cleanup.

title: BufferSize::Fixed semantics + callback sizing
description:
Align BufferSize::Fixed semantics across backends:
- Ensure requested fixed buffer size is respected or errors clearly when unsupported.
- Validate callback buffer length vs requested frames (best-effort; allow backend rounding where CPAL does).
- Add deterministic tests for size-to-bytes conversions and callback timing invariants.

title: Device enumeration parity: ids + default placeholder
description:
Bring device enumeration closer to upstream CPAL:
- Re-evaluate CoreAudio DeviceId (AudioDevice UID vs numeric ID) and default device handling.
- Ensure Host::devices ordering and uniqueness match upstream expectations where possible.
- Extend cmd/enumerate output + tests to catch regressions.
close_reason: Device enumeration parity: WASAPI uses real default endpoint IDs and no longer injects a synthetic 'default' device; JACK devices split into input/output with direction gating; added platform parity tests.

title: Callback timing/order tests for callback-thread model
description:
Add deterministic tests (preferably using the Null backend) that verify callback-thread model semantics match cpal-reference as closely as possible.

Goals:
- No data callbacks before play().
- After pause()/drop(), no further data callbacks (allow a small grace window for in-flight callbacks).
- Error callback ordering is deterministic (e.g., errors reported via error callback, not panics).
- BufferSize::Fixed: callback buffer length always equals frames*channels.

Acceptance:
- New test(s) are stable on GitHub Actions across macOS/Linux/Windows.
- Tests document tolerances (time windows) to avoid flakiness.
close_reason: Implemented native Null backend callback-thread streams (C worker thread) and added deterministic timing/order tests (no callbacks before play, pause/close stop callbacks, fixed buffer sizing).

title: Upstream parity plan: map cpal-reference files to MoonBit packages + port checklist

title: CoreAudio: avoid per-callback alloc/copy
description: Current AudioQueue callback bridge allocates a fresh MoonBit byte buffer per callback and copies between AudioQueueBuffer and MoonBit. This is functional but not RT-friendly.
acceptance_criteria: - No per-callback heap allocations on steady-state callbacks\n- Avoid extra memcpy where possible (e.g., map AudioQueueBuffer directly or reuse a preallocated MoonBit buffer)\n- No callback API breakage
close_reason: Eliminate per-callback heap allocation by preallocating MoonBit byte buffers (output ring + input scratch). Remaining work: reduce memcpy/zero-copy.

- Tests assert error callbacks are delivered after relevant backend events where we can simulate (e.g., JACK sample-rate invalidation/xrun flags) without calling MoonBit from RT threads.
- Tests skip gracefully when no default device is available.

comments.author: Milky2018
comments.text: Added cross-backend best-effort integration test ensuring output data callbacks do not fire before play(), do fire soon after play(), and largely stop after pause()/close(). Currently, running `moon build --target native` fails on macOS (arm64) with undefined symbol `_main`, because Moon tries to link per-package executables (e.g. _build/native/release/build/platform/platform.exe) even for library packages.

Acceptance:

- If the fix requires Moon toolchain changes, add a documented workaround (e.g. a script/command that performs an equivalent build check).

title: CoreAudio: improve callback timestamps
description: Input/Output callback timestamps are currently derived from mach_absolute_time at callback time. Use AudioQueue-provided timestamps (input start time) and/or device timing to better match cpal semantics.
acceptance_criteria: - InputCallbackInfo.capture uses AudioQueue inStartTime when available\n- OutputCallbackInfo.playback uses best available estimate\n- Monotonicity preserved
close_reason: Use AudioQueue timestamps when available: input capture uses inStartTime hostTime (or sampleTime fallback); output playback uses AudioQueueGetCurrentTime hostTime when available.

title: CoreAudio: reduce memcpy in callback bridge
description: Callback bridge still memcpy()s between MoonBit buffer and AudioQueueBuffer each callback (output) and from AudioQueueBuffer into MoonBit buffer (input). Investigate zero-copy or lower-copy approaches while preserving callback safety.
acceptance_criteria: - Reduce per-callback memcpy cost where possible (document limits)\n- Preserve current callback semantics (buffer valid only during callback)\n- Keep tests and macos_stream_smoke working
close_reason: No true zero-copy path found with current MoonBit ABI. Reduced callback bridge memory work: removed per-callback output memset (buffers are pre-zeroed once, callback expected to fully fill) and removed input remainder clearing; kept necessary memcpy between AudioQueue buffers and MoonBit buffers.

title: CoreAudio: explore zero-copy Data via external memory (blocked by MoonBit ABI)
description: Investigate whether MoonBit runtime can support creating a Byte array/Bytes view backed by an external pointer (AudioQueueBuffer mAudioData) with lifetime limited to callback. If not supported, document as limitation and keep memcpy.
acceptance_criteria: - Determine feasibility in MoonBit C backend/runtime\n- If feasible: prototype and measure\n- If infeasible: document clearly and close
close_reason: MoonBit C backend lacks a safe external-pointer-backed Bytes/FixedArray representation; documented constraints and kept memcpy (see macos/ZERO_COPY.md).
